3. Check NPC trade flags (type 0 and 1) for player GUID
4. If either flag set, exit (already processed)
5. Check questData+0x4f flag, if set exit (Cain rescued)
6. Check quest stage < 6, if >= 6 exit (wrong phase)
7. Send debug packet 0x255
8. Set quest bit for player (state 1)
9. Set quest state 7 with debug msg 0x9CF
10. Clear status byte, set quest state 5 with callback
11. Process NPC animations (type 0xD, quest 4)
12. Iterate party with callback 0x6fcb9730

Parameters:
  pGame - Game instance pointer (ECX, __fastcall)
  pUnit - Player unit pointer (EDX, __fastcall)

Returns:
  void

Quest Data Offsets:
  +0x4F: Cain rescued flag
  +0xE0: Player GUID array

Magic Numbers:
  4 - Search for Cain quest ID
  0x255 - Debug message ID
  0x9CF (2511) - State change debug ID
  0xD (13) - NPC animation type

0x6FCB9D40.name: InitializeCainQuestSpawnData
0x6FCB9D40.comment:
Initializes spawn data for the Search for Cain quest and triggers monster spawn.
Called when Cain rescue sequence begins to set up quest tracking data.

Algorithm:
1. Call FindClientById with quest ID 4 (Search for Cain)
2. If quest handler found, get quest data from +0x18
3. Store unit GUID from pEventData+0x4 at questData+0x6c
4. Set questData+0x70 = 1 (spawn flag)
5. Store X coordinate from pEventData+0x14 at questData+0x84
6. Store Y coordinate from pEventData+0x18 at questData+0x88
7. Check if questData+0x51 == 1 and questData+0x50 == 0
8. If conditions met, call SpawnCainQuestMonster with coordinates

Parameters:
  pEventData - Event callback data structure (ECX, __fastcall)
    +0x00: Game pointer
    +0x04: Unit pointer
    +0x08: Room pointer
    +0x14: X coordinate
    +0x18: Y coordinate

Returns:
  void

Quest Data Offsets:
  +0x6C: Tracked unit GUID
  +0x70: Spawn ready flag
  +0x84: Spawn X coordinate
  +0x88: Spawn Y coordinate
  +0x50: Quest completion flag
  +0x51: Quest active flag

0x6FCB9DA0.name: ProcessCainQuestHireCallback
0x6FCB9DA0.comment:
Callback for Search for Cain quest NPC hire interaction.
Processes Cain hiring logic when player interacts with rescued Cain.

Algorithm:
1. Allocate 12-byte stack frame
2. Save EBX, ESI, EDI; set ESI=param1 (game), EDI=param2 (unit)
3. Check trade flag type 0x0B (11) for quest 4
4. If flag set, return (already processed)
5. Get player class, check trade flag type 0x0A (10)
6. Check questHandler+0x50 for hire state
7. If not hired, check trade flag type 0x1A (26)
8. Check trade flag type 0x28 (40)
9. Get room from unit, validate
10. Process hire transaction if conditions met
11. Spawn Cain in town if successful

Parameters:
  pGame - Game instance pointer (ECX, __fastcall)
  pUnit - Player/Cain unit pointer (EDX, __fastcall)

Returns:
  void

Quest Trade Flag Types:
  0x0B (11) - Quest complete flag
  0x0A (10) - Primary interaction flag
  0x1A (26) - Secondary interaction flag
  0x28 (40) - Tertiary interaction flag

Note: Function body appears truncated in Ghidra analysis.
Manual disassembly shows complex quest processing logic.

0x6FCB9ED0.name: ScheduleQuestUnitAnimationEvent
0x6FCB9ED0.comment:
Schedules a delayed animation event for a quest-related unit.
Sets animation mode 1 and schedules event type 7 after 25 game ticks.

Algorithm:
1. Set unit animation mode to 1 via SetUnitAnimationMode
2. Get current game tick from pEventData[0]+0x70
3. Add 0x19 (25) ticks for delay
4. Schedule unit event type 7 at calculated tick time

Parameters:
  pEventData - Event callback data structure (ECX, __fastcall)
    +0x00: Game pointer (contains tick at +0x70)
    +0x04: Unit pointer to animate

Returns:
  void

Magic Numbers:
  1 - Animation mode (idle/default)
  7 - Event type for scheduled callback
  0x19 (25) - Tick delay for scheduled event
  0x70 - Offset to game tick counter

0x6FCB9F00.name: ProcessQuestEntityAnimationEvent
0x6FCB9F00.comment:
Processes quest entity animation events and schedules follow-up events.
Called from ProcessEntityMessage to handle animation state transitions.

Algorithm:
1. Read event type from pEventData+0xC
2. Switch on event type:
   - Type 1: Set animation mode 2
   - Type 2: Check entity field, increment counter at questData+0x80
     - If counter > 5, set flag at questData+0x92
     - If +0x92 flag set, use animation mode 3
     - Else check +0x91 flag for mode 3
   - Type 3: Set animation mode 4
3. Get game tick from game+0x70, add 0x19 (25 ticks)
4. Schedule unit event type 7 with calculated tick

Parameters:
  pQuestHandler - Quest handler structure (ECX, __fastcall)
    +0x04: Game pointer
    +0x18: Quest data pointer
  pEventData - Event callback data (EDX, __fastcall)
    +0x0C: Event type code (1, 2, or 3)

Returns:
  void

Quest Data Offsets:
  +0x80: Animation cycle counter (incremented on type 2)
  +0x91: Secondary animation flag
  +0x92: Animation complete flag (set when counter > 5)

Magic Numbers:
  1, 2, 3 - Event type codes
  2, 3, 4 - Animation mode values
  5 - Counter threshold for completion
  7 - Scheduled event type
  0x19 (25) - Tick delay for scheduled event

0x6FCB9F90.name: GetCainQuestTargetCoordinates
0x6FCB9F90.comment:
Gets target coordinates for Search for Cain quest pathfinding.
Returns stored coordinates if quest conditions are met.

Algorithm:
1. Call FindClientById(4) to get quest handler
2. If handler not found, return 0
3. Check quest active flag at handler+0x9
4. Check questData+0x96 flag (must be set)
5. Check questData+0x92 flag (must NOT be set)
6. If all conditions pass:
   a. Copy X coordinate from questData+0xA8 to output[0]
   b. Copy Y coordinate from questData+0xAC to output[1]
   c. Return 1
7. Otherwise return 0

Parameters:
  this - Game instance pointer (ECX, __thiscall)
  pOutCoords - Output coordinate buffer (stack param)
    [0]: X coordinate (DWORD)
    [4]: Y coordinate (DWORD)

Returns:
  1 - Coordinates successfully retrieved
  0 - Quest not active or conditions not met

Quest Data Offsets:
  +0x09: Quest active flag (handler offset)
  +0x92: Completion flag (must be 0)
  +0x96: Target valid flag (must be 1)
  +0xA8: Target X coordinate
  +0xAC: Target Y coordinate

0x6FCB9FE0.name: SpawnClientMissile
0x6FCB9FE0.comment:
Spawns a missile unit for a client player at their current coordinates.

Algorithm:
1. Find client by ID 4 in the game
2. Check if missile not already spawned (flag at offset 0x95)
3. Get client's X/Y coordinates from offsets 0x9c/0xa0
4. Find region at those coordinates via GetRoom and FindRegionByCoordinates
5. If no valid region, nudge coordinates by +3 and return (retry next tick)
6. Allocate missile unit (type=2, class=0xBD) at client position
7. If allocation succeeds, mark flag and store missile unit ID

Parameters:
pGame - Pointer to game state structure
pRoom - Pointer to room/area structure

Returns:
Always returns 1

Magic Numbers:
0x95 - Client data flag: missile spawned (0=no, 1=yes)
0x98 - Client data field: spawned missile unit ID
0x9c - Client data field: X coordinate
0xa0 - Client data field: Y coordinate
0xBD (189) - Missile class ID
2 - Unit type for MISSILE
4 - Client lookup type parameter

0x6FCBA0A0.name: GetClientOwnerPosition
0x6FCBA0A0.signature: int GetClientOwnerPosition(int * pGame, UnitAny * pUnit, int * pOutPosition)
0x6FCBA0A0.comment:
Gets the owner position coordinates for a client.

Algorithm:
1. Find client by ID with type 4
2. If client not found, return 0 (failure)
3. Get client data structure from client[6]
4. Check spawn flag at offset 0x95
5. If spawn flag is 0, call GetOwnerInfo to get position from unit
6. If spawn flag is non-zero, read cached position from client data
7. Return 1 (success)

Parameters:
  pGame - Game instance pointer (ECX, __fastcall)
  pUnit - Unit to get owner info from (EDX, __fastcall)
  pOutPosition - Output buffer for X,Y coordinates [2 DWORDs] (stack)

Returns:
  1 on success (position written to pOutPosition)
  0 if client not found

Structure Layout (ClientData at client[6]):
  Offset  Size  Field         Description
  0x95    1     bSpawnFlag    Non-zero if position is cached
  0x9c    4     nCachedX      Cached X coordinate
  0xa0    4     nCachedY      Cached Y coordinate

0x6FCBA100.name: SetClientOwnerInfo
0x6FCBA100.comment:
Sets owner information for a client associated with a unit.

Algorithm:
1. Find client structure using constant client ID 4
2. If client not found, return 0 (failure)
3. Get client data structure at offset 0x18
4. Check if owner info flag at offset 0x67 is already set
5. If flag set, return 0 (already processed)
6. Call GetOwnerInfo to populate owner data at offset 0x9c
7. Set owner info flag to 1 at offset 0x67
8. Return 1 (success)

Parameters:
  pGame (ECX) - Pointer to game structure for client lookup
  pUnit (EDX) - Unit whose owner info to retrieve

Returns:
  1 - Owner info successfully set on client
  0 - Client not found or owner info already set

Structure Offsets (Client Data at [Client+0x18]):
  +0x67 - byte  - Owner info set flag (0=unset, 1=set)
  +0x9c - uint* - Owner info data buffer (populated by GetOwnerInfo)

0x6FCBA140.name: ProcessCainQuestState
0x6FCBA140.comment:
Processes and updates the Cain quest state for a game session.

Algorithm:
1. Find client by ID 4 (quest client type)
2. Set quest active flags at offsets 0x91 and 0x51
3. If missile flag (0x70) is set:
   a. Find missile unit by GUID stored at offset 0x6c
   b. Get missile's room, owner GUID, and Y coordinate
   c. Update quest data with missile info
   d. If conditions met, spawn Cain quest monster
4. If monster flag (0x50) is set:
   a. Find monster unit by GUID stored at offset 0x68
   b. Get owner coordinates
   c. Find region at those coordinates
   d. Allocate missile (type 2, class 0xBD) at position
   e. Set spawn flag (0x96) and store missile GUID

Parameters:
  pGame - Game instance pointer (ECX, __fastcall)

Returns: void

Magic Numbers:
  4 - Client ID for quest type
  2 - Unit type MISSILE
  1 - Unit type MONSTER
  0xBD (189) - Missile class ID
  0x6c - Missile GUID offset in quest data
  0x68 - Monster GUID offset in quest data

0x6FCBA280.name: SetCainQuestCompleteFlag
0x6FCBA280.comment:
Sets the Cain quest completion flag for the game session.

Algorithm:
1. Find quest client by ID 4
2. If client found, set completion flag at offset 0x92 to 1

Parameters:
  pGame - Game instance pointer (ECX, __fastcall)

Returns: void

Magic Numbers:
  4 - Client ID for quest type
  0x92 - Quest completion flag offset in quest data structure

0x6FCBA2A0.name: IsQuestFlagActive
0x6FCBA2A0.comment:
Checks if a quest flag is set for a client player.

Algorithm:
1. Find client by ID 4 in the game structure
2. If client not found, return false
3. Get client data pointer from client[6] (offset 0x18)
4. Check quest flag byte at offset 0x93 in client data
5. Return true if flag is non-zero, false otherwise

Parameters:
pGame - Pointer to game state structure (in ECX via __fastcall)

Returns:
true - Quest flag is active (byte at offset 0x93 != 0)
false - Client not found or quest flag is inactive

Magic Numbers:
0x93 - Client data offset for quest active flag
4 - Client lookup type parameter
0x18 - Offset to client data pointer in client structure

0x6FCBA2D0.name: SpawnQuestGoldDrop
0x6FCBA2D0.comment:
Spawns gold drops from a quest entity with randomized count.

Algorithm:
1. If not initialized (flag 0x90 == 0):
   a. Set initialization flag (0x90) to 1
   b. Get quest RNG seed
   c. Generate random drop count in range 10-20
   d. Store count at offset 0x8c
   e. Set gold marker "gld " (0x20646c67) on unit at offset 0xDC
2. While drop count > 0:
   a. Spawn random gold item (type 2, class 0x5B)
   b. Decrement remaining count
   c. If more drops remain, schedule next drop event in 10 ticks

Parameters:
  pQuestData - Quest data structure pointer (ECX, __fastcall)
  pUnit - Unit spawning the gold (EDX, __fastcall)

Returns: void

Magic Numbers:
  0x5B (91) - Item class for gold
  2 - Item type
  7 - Event type for scheduled gold drop
  10 - Tick delay between gold spawns
  10-20 - Random range for total gold drop count
  0x20646c67 - "gld " ASCII marker

0x6FCBA370.name: HandleQuestObjectInteraction
0x6FCBA370.comment:
Handles interaction with a quest object, updating animation and quest state.

Algorithm:
1. Check if object's field_c is 0 (not yet activated)
2. If inactive, set animation mode to 1 and schedule unit event
3. Look up quest client by ID 5
4. If quest client exists and is active (byte +0x9 != 0):
   a. Send quest message packet with code 0x7F
   b. If quest state < 2, advance to state 2
   c. If byte +0xB is 0, set quest data flag at +0x11B

Parameters:
pEventData - Event data structure containing:
  [0] = pGame (game pointer)
  [1] = pObject (UnitAny* object being interacted with)
  [2] = pPlayer (UnitAny* player performing interaction)
  [4] = nObjectClassId (object type/class identifier)

Returns:
Always returns 0

Magic Numbers:
0x7F - Quest message packet code
0x11B - Quest data flag offset (quest object activated)
0xDC - Object data timing offset (shifted right 8 bits)

0x6FCBA400.name: UpdateQuestStateForPlayer
0x6FCBA400.comment:
Updates quest state for a player based on NPC trade flags.

Algorithm:
1. Get player's monster class pointer via GetPlayerMonsterClassPtr
2. Read quest index from pQuestData offset 0x4d
3. Get trade flags array from monster class at [index*4 + 0x10]
4. Check if NPC trade flag 0 is set for quest 5
5. If flag 0 set, check flags 0xd and 0xe are NOT set
6. If conditions met (flag 0 set, 0xd/0xe not set), skip packet
7. Otherwise send quest state packet to player for quest 5

Parameters:
pQuestData - Pointer to quest data structure (contains quest index at +0x4d)
pPlayer - Pointer to player UnitAny structure

Returns:
Always returns 0

Magic Numbers:
0x4d - Offset to quest index byte in quest data
0x10 - Base offset in monster class for trade flags array
5 - Quest ID (likely Act 5 quest)
0 - Initial trade flag to check (quest started)
0xd (13) - Trade flag for quest completion state
0xe (14) - Trade flag for quest reward state

0x6FCBA460.name: UpdateQuestProgressFlags
0x6FCBA460.comment:
Updates quest progress flags based on client state for quest 5.

Algorithm:
1. Get player's monster class pointer and trade flags array
2. Check if NPC trade flag 0 is already set for quest 5 - if so, return
3. Check if NPC trade flag 1 is already set for quest 5 - if so, return
4. Find client by ID 5 in quest data
5. If client not found, return
6. Check client state byte at offset 0xc:
   - If state == 2: Set flag bit 2 for quest 5
   - If state == 3: Check sub-state at offset 0xb and set flag 3-6

Parameters:
pQuestData - Pointer to quest data structure (in ECX via __fastcall)
pPlayer - Pointer to player unit (in EDX via __fastcall)

Returns:
Always returns 0

Magic Numbers:
0x4d - Quest data offset for player index byte
0x10 - Offset to trade flags array in monster class
5 - Quest ID (Act 5 quest)
0xc - Client structure offset for state byte
0xb - Client structure offset for sub-state byte
2-6 - Flag bit indices set based on quest progress

0x6FCBA530.name: IsUnitInTrackingList
0x6FCBA530.signature: bool IsUnitInTrackingList(int * pQuestData, int nEventType, int * pUnit)
0x6FCBA530.comment:
Checks if a unit's ID exists in the quest tracking list.

Algorithm:
1. Get tracking list count from word at offset 0x64 in quest data structure
2. Get unit ID from pUnit offset 0x8
3. Iterate through tracking array starting at offset 0x34
4. Compare each entry against the target unit ID
5. If found and event type is NOT 0x9B or 0x93, return true
6. Return false if not found or if excluded event type

Parameters:
pQuestData - Pointer to quest data structure (in ECX)
nEventType - Event type ID to check exclusions (in EDX)
pUnit - Pointer to unit structure (on stack)

Returns:
true (1) - Unit found in list and event type not excluded
false (0) - Unit not found OR event type is 0x9B/0x93

Magic Numbers:
0x64 - Offset to tracking list count (word)
0x34 - Offset to tracking list array start
0x9B (155) - Excluded event type
0x93 (147) - Excluded event type

0x6FCBA580.name: InitQuestFlagsForTier
0x6FCBA580.comment:
Initializes quest flags based on character tier level.

Algorithm:
1. Get player's monster class pointer and bit array for quest flags
2. Check if NPC trade flag 0 is already set for quest 5
3. If flag 0 not set, get player's room and entity field
4. Get character tier index from experience/level
5. If tier is 0 (lowest), set flags 0xD and 0 for quest 5

Parameters:
pQuestData - Pointer to quest data structure (in ECX via __fastcall)
pPlayer - Pointer to player UnitAny (in EDX via __fastcall)

Returns:
void

Magic Numbers:
0x4d - Offset in quest data for player index byte
5 - Quest ID being checked/modified
0xD - Quest flag for tier-based initialization
0 - Quest flag for initial state

Note: Function boundaries appear truncated in Ghidra.

0x6FCBA5E0.name: InitiateMissileSequence
0x6FCBA5E0.comment:
InitiateMissileSequence - Initiates a missile targeting sequence for multi-target effects.

Algorithm:
1. Calls ProcessMissileTargetSpawning to spawn missiles at each target in the list
2. Retrieves missile state structure from context offset 0x18
3. Checks if effect is active (flag at offset 0x118 != 0)
4. Checks if effect not yet processed (flag at offset 0x119 == 0)
5. If both conditions met, schedules follow-up event type 7
6. Event scheduled 10 frames after current game frame (offset 0x70)

Parameters:
  nContext (ECX) - Missile context structure containing:
    +0x04: pGame - Game instance pointer
    +0x18: pMissileState - Missile state/configuration struct
  pUnit (EDX) - Unit pointer for event scheduling callback

Returns: void

Special Cases:
  - No event scheduled if effect already processed (flag at 0x119 != 0)
  - No event scheduled if effect not active (flag at 0x118 == 0)

Magic Numbers:
  0x04 - Game pointer offset in missile context
  0x18 - Missile state pointer offset in missile context
  0x70 - Current game frame offset in game structure
  0x118 - Active flag offset in missile state
  0x119 - Processed flag offset in missile state
  7 - Event type for missile sequence continuation
  10 - Frame delay for follow-up event

0x6FCBA620.name: ProcessMissileTargetSpawning
0x6FCBA620.comment:
Processes missile spawning for multiple target units.

Algorithm:
1. Check activation flag at offset 0x118 (must be set) and processed flag at 0x119 (must be clear)
2. Get target count from word at offset 0x88
3. Iterate through target GUID array starting at offset 0x68
4. For each target, find the unit by GUID (type 2 = missile)
5. Get spawn coordinates from offsets 0x110 (X) and 0x114 (Y)
6. Find region at coordinates and spawn monster (type 0x146, class 0xC)
7. If spawn fails, adjust coordinates by +5 and retry
8. Mark processed flag (offset 0x119 = 1)
9. Get target unit position and create related missile (type 0x14C)
10. Configure missile targeting and room flags

Parameters:
pGame - Pointer to game state structure (in ECX)
pMissileData - Pointer to missile data structure (in EDX)

Returns:
void

Magic Numbers:
0x118 - Activation flag offset (byte)
0x119 - Processed flag offset (byte)
0x88 - Target count offset (word)
0x68 - Target GUID array offset
0x110 - Spawn X coordinate offset
0x114 - Spawn Y coordinate offset
0x146 (326) - Monster type for spawn
0xC (12) - Monster class
0x14C (332) - Related missile type
2 - Unit type (MISSILE) for FindUnitByGuid

0x6FCBA7B0.name: InitializeQuestHandlers
0x6FCBA7B0.comment:
Initializes quest handler structure with function pointers and allocates state buffer.

Algorithm:
1. Zero out 15 dwords (60 bytes) starting at offset 0xA0
2. Clear control bytes at offsets 0xB, 0xC
3. Set up quest handler function pointers at multiple offsets
4. Set quest ID value (5) at offset 0xE0
5. Set data table pointer at offset 0xDC
6. Set control bytes at offsets 0xA (=1) and 0xD (=4)
7. Allocate 0x120 bytes of tracked pool memory for quest state
8. Store allocated buffer pointer at offset 0x18
9. Set value 3 at offset 0x10
10. Zero out 72 dwords in allocated buffer
11. Clear dword array at buffer+0x8C

Parameters:
pQuestData - Pointer to quest data structure to initialize (in ECX)

Returns:
void

Handler Function Pointer Layout:
0xA0 - FUN_6fcbab70
0xAC - FUN_6fcbace0
0xC0 - FUN_6fcbaec0
0xC8 - FUN_6fcbab30
0xCC - FUN_6fcba880
0xD4 - LAB_6fcbb2e0
0xE8 - IsUnitInTrackingList
0xEC - FUN_6fcbae40

Magic Numbers:
0x120 (288) - Size of quest state buffer
0x48 (72) - Dword count to zero in state buffer
0x8C (140) - Offset to dword array in state buffer
5 - Quest ID stored at offset 0xE0

0x6FCBA880.name: HandleToolsOfTradeNpcInteraction
0x6FCBA880.comment:
Handles NPC interaction events for the Tools of the Trade quest (Quest ID 5).

Algorithm:
1. Extract interaction type (offset 0x18) and NPC class ID (offset 0x14) from message
2. Get quest data buffer pointer from pQuestInfo+0x18
3. If interaction type is 0x7F (waypoint/special) and quest is active:
   a. Check if Charsi has given quest (data+0x11B == 1)
   b. If quest state is 0, advance to state 1 and iterate players
   c. If quest state is 3, advance to state 2, iterate players, set to state 3
   d. Ensure minimum state 2, then call UpdateQuestProgressFlags
4. If NPC class ID matches quest-relevant NPCs and interaction matches Act 1 town NPCs:
   a. Check if NPC trade flag 5/0xD is set (tool given)
   b. Clear pending flag (data+0x11A), advance to state 5, execute sequence callback
   c. Search pending NPC list for unit GUID, remove if found
   d. If removal succeeded and tracked list has room (<12), add GUID to tracked list

Parameters:
  pQuestInfo (ECX) - Quest instance pointer with handler callbacks
  pQuestMsg (EDX) - Quest message with NPC class/interaction data

Returns: void

Structure Access:
  Offset  Size  Field          Description
  +0x04   4     pGame          Game instance pointer
  +0x09   1     bQuestActive   Quest active flag
  +0x0B   1     bQuestState    Current quest state byte
  +0x0C   1     bStateLevel    State progress level
  +0x14   1     bControlFlag   Control/iteration flag
  +0x18   4     pQuestData     Quest data buffer (288 bytes)
  +0xEC   4     pfnSequence    Sequence callback function pointer

Quest Data Buffer (at pQuestData):
  +0x00   48    anTrackedGuids Array of tracked unit GUIDs (max 12)
  +0x30   2     wTrackedCount  Count of tracked GUIDs
  +0x34   48    anPendingGuids Array of pending unit GUIDs (max 12)
  +0x64   2     wPendingCount  Count of pending GUIDs
  +0x11A  1     bPendingFlag   Pending interaction flag
  +0x11B  1     bCharsiGave    Charsi gave quest item flag

Quest Message (at pQuestMsg):
  +0x00   4     pMsgData       Message data pointer
  +0x0C   4     pPlayerUnit    Player unit pointer
  +0x14   2     wNpcClassId    NPC class identifier (low word of [5])
  +0x18   2     wInteraction   Interaction type (low word of [6])

Magic Numbers:
  0x7F    - Special/waypoint interaction type
  0x9A    - Charsi NPC class
  0x96    - Gheed NPC class
  0x109   - Larzuk NPC class (Act 5)
  0x9B    - Kashya NPC class
  0x94    - Akara NPC class
  0x93    - Warriv NPC class
  0x90-0x91, 0x8C-0x8F - Act 1 town interaction classes
  5       - Quest ID for Tools of the Trade
  0xD (13)- Trade flag for quest item given

0x6FCBAAA0.name: RemoveUnitFromTrackingList
0x6FCBAAA0.signature: int RemoveUnitFromTrackingList(int * pQuestState, int nUnitId, int nListIndex)
0x6FCBAAA0.comment:
Removes a unit ID from one of two tracking arrays in quest state structure.

Algorithm:
1. Select target array based on nListIndex (0=primary at offset 0x00, nonzero=secondary at offset 0x34)
2. Get array count from structure (offset 0x30 or 0x64)
3. Linear search for matching unit ID
4. If found, swap-remove: copy last element to found index, decrement count
5. Return 1 if removed, 0 if not found

Parameters:
  pQuestState (ECX) - Quest state buffer pointer
  nUnitId (EDX) - Unit ID to remove from list
  nListIndex (stack) - Which list: 0=primary array, nonzero=secondary array

Returns:
  1 - Unit found and removed
  0 - Unit not found in list

Structure Layout:
  Offset  Size  Field           Description
  +0x00   48    anPrimaryList   Primary unit ID array (12 dwords)
  +0x30   2     wPrimaryCount   Count of primary list entries
  +0x34   48    anSecondaryList Secondary unit ID array (12 dwords)
  +0x64   2     wSecondaryCount Count of secondary list entries

Notes:
  Uses swap-with-last removal for O(1) delete, O(n) search
  Maximum 12 entries per list (0xC limit checked by callers)

0x6FCBAB30.name: RemoveUnitFromQuestTracking
0x6FCBAB30.comment:
Removes a unit from all quest tracking lists when the unit leaves or dies.

Algorithm:
1. Get quest state buffer from pQuestInfo+0x18
2. Extract unit ID from pQuestMsg->pUnit->dwUnitId (offset 0xC then +0x8)
3. Remove unit ID from the dword array at state buffer offset 0x8C
4. Remove from active tracking list (flag=1)
5. Remove from pending tracking list (flag=0)

Parameters:
  pQuestInfo (ECX) - Quest instance pointer
  pQuestMsg (EDX) - Quest message containing unit reference

Returns:
  void

Quest State Buffer Access:
  Offset 0x8C (piVar1+0x23) - Dword array of tracked unit IDs

0x6FCBAB70.name: CollectToolsOfTradeQuestStats
0x6FCBAB70.comment:
Collects quest statistics for Tools of the Trade quest based on NPC interaction state.

Algorithm:
1. Verify quest is active (pQuestInfo+0x09 != 0)
2. Get player's monster class pointer and trade flags for NPC
3. Check trade flags 5/0 (quest available) and 5/0xD (tool given)
4. If quest not available or tool already given, exit early
5. Get quest data buffer, player room GUID, and NPC unit GUID
6. If quest progress > 3, search pending and tracked NPC lists for GUID
7. Based on list membership and trade flag state:
   a. If in pending list: collect stats with type 2
   b. If both flags set and in tracked list: collect stats with type 3
   c. Otherwise: use state-based table lookup for stat type

Parameters:
  pQuestInfo (ECX) - Quest instance pointer
  pQuestMsg (EDX) - Quest message with player/NPC data

Returns: void

Quest Data Buffer Access:
  +0x00   48    Tracked GUID list (max 12 entries)
  +0x30   2     wTrackedCount
  +0x34   48    Pending GUID list (max 12 entries)  
  +0x64   2     wPendingCount

Quest Message Access:
  +0x00   4     pMsgData (byte at +0x4D = difficulty index)
  +0x08   4     pRoomData (dword at +0x04 = room GUID)
  +0x0C   4     pPlayerUnit (dword at +0x08 = unit GUID)
  +0x14   4     pStatList for CollectStatsByTypeToList

Magic Numbers:
  5       - Trade flag category for quest items
  0       - Trade flag: quest item available
  0xD (13)- Trade flag: quest item given
  2       - Stat collection type: pending NPC
  3       - Stat collection type: tracked NPC

State Table (DAT_6fd38d9c):
  Index by quest progress byte (pQuestInfo+0x0C)
  Returns stat collection type or 0xFFFFFFFF if invalid

0x6FCBACE0.name: HandleToolsOfTradeDialogEvent
0x6FCBACE0.comment:
Handles dialog/talk events for the Tools of the Trade quest (Quest ID 5).

Algorithm:
1. If quest not active (quest+0x09 == 0), jump to check message type 1
2. If message type is 0x14 (talk start):
   a. If state level is 0, set to state 2, then iterate with state 3
   b. If state level <= 3 and quest state is 1, iterate with state 4
3. If message type is 0x19 (talk end):
   a. If state level < 4 and quest state != 2:
      - If state level != 3, advance to state 3
      - Clear control flag, iterate with state 2
4. If message type is 1 (quest status check):
   a. If state level is 2:
      - Check NPC trade flag for quest item
      - If not traded (flag != 1), advance to state 3
   b. If state level is 5 and quest active:
      - Remove player unit from tracking list
      - If both tracking lists empty, clear quest active flag

Parameters:
  pQuestInfo (ECX) - Quest instance pointer
  pQuestMsg (EDX) - Quest message with type and player data

Returns: void

Structure Access (pQuestInfo):
  Offset  Size  Field         Description
  +0x04   4     pGame         Game instance pointer
  +0x09   1     bQuestActive  Quest active flag
  +0x0A   1     bActiveFlag   Quest active control flag
  +0x0B   1     bQuestState   Current quest state byte
  +0x0C   1     bStateLevel   State progress level
  +0x14   1     bControlFlag  Control/iteration flag
  +0x18   4     pQuestData    Quest data buffer pointer
  +0xE0   4     nQuestId      Quest ID value (5)

Quest Message (pQuestMsg):
  +0x00   4     pMsgData      Message data pointer
  +0x0C   4     pPlayerUnit   Player unit pointer
  +0x14   4     nMsgParam     Message parameter
  +0x18   4     nMsgType      Message type (0x14=talk start, 0x19=talk end, 1=check)

Magic Numbers:
  0x14 (20) - Talk start message type
  0x19 (25) - Talk end message type
  1         - Quest status check message type
  2,3,4,5   - Quest state progression levels

0x6FCBAE40.name: CanExecuteToolsOfTradeSequence
0x6FCBAE40.comment:
Determines if the Tools of the Trade quest sequence callback can execute.

Algorithm:
1. Check if quest progress level < 2 AND quest active flag == 1
   - Return 1 (allow) - early quest stage permits sequence
2. Check if quest progress level != 5 AND quest is active
   - Return 1 (allow) - quest not complete permits sequence
3. Look up client by stored client ID
   - If client not found, return 0 (deny)
4. Validate sequence callback pointer at client+0xEC
   - Assert and exit if invalid
5. Call client's sequence callback and return its result

Parameters:
  pQuestInfo (ECX) - Quest instance pointer

Returns:
  int - 1 if sequence can execute, 0 if denied

Structure Access (pQuestInfo):
  Offset  Size  Field          Description
  +0x04   4     pGame          Game instance pointer
  +0x09   1     bQuestActive   Quest active flag (1=active)
  +0x0C   1     bProgressLevel Quest progress level
  +0x10   4     nClientId      Client ID for lookup
  +0xEC   4     pfnSequence    Sequence callback pointer

Magic Numbers:
  2 - Minimum progress level for standard check
  5 - Quest complete state
  0x2E0 (736) - Assert line number

0x6FCBAEC0.name: CompleteToolsOfTradeQuest
0x6FCBAEC0.comment:
Handles completion of the Tools of the Trade quest (Quest ID 5).

Algorithm:
1. Get quest data buffer and store owner info from player unit
2. If quest is active:
   a. Send debug packet "Finished quest"
   b. Clear quest handler at offset 0xA8, set quest state to 5
   c. Set pending flag (data+0x11A = 1)
   d. Iterate game with FUN_6fcbb150 callback
   e. Set quest bit 5/0xD for player (tool given flag)
   f. If no tracked units, clear active flag; else set removal handler
   g. Set completion flag (data+0x118 = 1), clear handler at 0xC0
   h. Set quest bit for message sender
   i. Iterate with FUN_6fcbb0b0 and FUN_6fcbb260/FUN_6fcbb210 callbacks
   j. For each tracked unit GUID:
      - Find unit by GUID
      - Check NPC trade flag for quest availability
      - If not available, set both 0xD and 0 flags, set interaction mode 0x24
   k. Add 7-tick timer callback for FUN_6fcbb2b0
3. Process missile target spawning
4. If spawn not complete (data+0x119 == 0), schedule unit event for 10 ticks

Parameters:
  pQuestInfo (ECX) - Quest instance pointer
  pQuestMsg (EDX) - Quest message with game/player data

Returns: void

Quest Data Buffer (pMissileData = pQuestInfo[6]):
  +0x8C   4     pOwnerGuidList - List of NPC GUIDs being tracked
  +0x10C  2     wTrackedCount - Count at offset 0x43 (relative to buffer)
  +0x118  1     bCompleteFlag
  +0x119  1     bSpawnComplete
  +0x11A  1     bPendingFlag

Quest Info Structure:
  +0x04   4     pGame
  +0x09   1     bQuestActive
  +0x0A   1     bActiveFlag (cleared on no tracked units)
  +0x18   4     pQuestData
  +0xA8   4     handler cleared on completion
  +0xC0   4     handler cleared/set to RemoveUnitFromQuestTracking
  +0xE0   4     nQuestId (5)

Magic Numbers:
  5       - Quest ID for Tools of the Trade
  0xD (13)- Trade flag: tool given
  0       - Trade flag: quest available
  0x24    - NPC interaction mode (reward available)
  7       - Timer callback delay in ticks
  10      - Schedule event delay added to game tick

0x6FCBB0B0.name: RegisterNpcForToolsOfTradeQuest
0x6FCBB0B0.comment:
Registers an NPC for the Tools of the Trade quest when spawned in Act 1.

Algorithm:
1. Get player's monster class pointer from NPC unit
2. Get trade flags array using difficulty index from pMsgData+0x4D
3. Check if trade flag 5/0 (quest available) is NOT set - if set, exit
4. Check if trade flag 5/1 (quest started) is NOT set - if set, exit
5. Get room from NPC unit and verify it exists
6. Get entity field from room and verify it equals 0x19 (Act 1)
7. Find quest 5 (Tools of the Trade) client data by ID
8. If found, get quest data buffer from client+0x18
9. Get NPC unit GUID from pNpcUnit+0x08
10. Check if GUID already in tracking array at buffer+0x8C
11. If not present, add GUID to tracking array
12. Set trade flags 5/0 (available) and 5/0xD (tool given)

Parameters:
  pMsgData (ECX) - Message data with difficulty at +0x4D
  pNpcUnit (EDX) - NPC unit pointer with GUID at +0x08

Returns:
  Always returns 0

Trade Flags Used:
  5/0   - Quest item available flag
  5/1   - Quest started flag  
  5/0xD - Tool given flag

Magic Numbers:
  5     - Quest ID for Tools of the Trade
  0x19  - Act 1 identifier (decimal 25)
  0x4D  - Offset to difficulty index in message data
  0x8C  - Offset to NPC tracking array in quest data buffer

0x6FCBB150.name: ProcessToolsOfTradeNpcActivation
0x6FCBB150.comment:
Processes NPC activation for Tools of the Trade quest when player enters NPC's room.

Algorithm:
1. Get player's monster class pointer and NPC trade flag array
2. Check if trade flag 5/0 is already set (quest available) - exit if true
3. Get NPC's room and verify room type is 0x19 (Act 1 town)
4. If in correct room type:
   a. Set trade flags 5/0xD (tool given), 5/0 (quest available)
   b. Clear trade flag 5/1 (quest in progress)
   c. Set unit interaction mode to 0x24 (dialogue available)
   d. Find quest 5 data and add NPC GUID to pending list (max 12)
5. If not in correct room: set trade flag 5/0xE (invalid location)

Parameters:
  pMsgData (ECX) - Message data with difficulty index at +0x4D
  pNpcUnit (EDX) - NPC unit pointer with GUID at +0x08

Returns: 0 always

Trade Flag Operations:
  SetBitInArray2D(flags, 5, 0xD) - Mark tool as given
  SetBitInArray2D(flags, 5, 0x0) - Mark quest available
  ClearBitInGrid(flags, 5, 0x1) - Clear in-progress flag
  SetBitInArray2D(flags, 5, 0xE) - Mark invalid location

Quest Data Buffer Access:
  +0x34   48    Pending NPC GUID list (max 12 entries)
  +0x64   2     wPendingCount

Magic Numbers:
  0x19    - Act 1 town room type
  0x24    - Dialogue available interaction mode
  5       - Quest ID / trade flag category
  0xC (12)- Maximum pending NPC list size

0x6FCBB210.name: HandleToolsOfTradeInvalidLocation
0x6FCBB210.comment:
Handles Tools of the Trade quest when NPC is in invalid location.

Algorithm:
1. Get player's monster class pointer and NPC trade flag array
2. Check if trade flag 5/0 is already set (quest available)
3. If not set: mark location invalid (flag 5/0xE) and send item effect

Parameters:
  pMsgData (ECX) - Message data with difficulty index at +0x4D
  pNpcUnit (EDX) - NPC unit pointer

Returns: 0 always

Trade Flag Operations:
  SetBitInArray2D(flags, 5, 0xE) - Mark invalid location

Magic Numbers:
  5       - Quest ID / trade flag category
  0xE (14)- Invalid location trade flag

0x6FCBB260.name: PropagateToolsOfTradeToParty
0x6FCBB260.comment:
Propagates Tools of the Trade quest completion to party members.

Algorithm:
1. Get player's monster class pointer and NPC trade flags
2. Check if trade flag 5/0xD is set (tool given/quest complete)
3. If quest complete:
   a. Get player's party slot index
   b. If player is in a party (slot != -1), iterate all party members
   c. Call InitQuestFlagsForTier callback for each party member

Parameters:
  pMsgData (ECX) - Message data with difficulty index at +0x4D
  pPlayerUnit (EDX) - Player unit who completed the quest

Returns: 0 always

Trade Flag Check:
  IsNpcTradeFlagSet(flags, 5, 0xD) - Check if tool was given

Party Iteration:
  IteratePartyMembers(pMsgData, nPartySlot, InitQuestFlagsForTier, 0)
  - Applies quest completion flags to all party members

Magic Numbers:
  5       - Quest ID / trade flag category
  0xD (13)- Trade flag: tool given (quest complete)
  -1      - Invalid party slot (not in party)

0x6FCBB2B0.name: CompleteToolsOfTradeQuest
0x6FCBB2B0.comment:
Completes the Tools of the Trade quest when player receives the imbued item.

Algorithm:
1. Get quest data buffer pointer from pQuestInfo+0x18
2. If quest progress is at state 5 (tool retrieved):
   a. Clear control flag at pQuestInfo+0x14
   b. Set quest state to 0x0D (complete) and iterate players
3. Clear completion flag at questData+0x11C
4. Return 1 (success)

Parameters:
  nUnused (ECX) - Unused parameter (passed for callback compatibility)
  pQuestInfo (EDX) - Quest instance pointer

Returns: 1 always (success)

Quest Structure Access:
  +0x0C   1     bQuestProgress - Quest progress state
  +0x14   1     bControlFlag   - Control/iteration flag
  +0x18   4     pQuestData     - Quest data buffer pointer

Quest Data Access:
  +0x11C  1     bCompletionFlag - Cleared on completion

Magic Numbers:
  5       - Quest state: tool retrieved, ready for completion
  0x0D    - Quest state: completed

0x6FCBB3B0.name: SetToolsOfTradeUnitAnimation
0x6FCBB3B0.comment:
Sets unit animation mode for Tools of the Trade quest callback.

Algorithm:
1. Find quest 5 (Tools of the Trade) instance by ID
2. Assert quest info exists (fatal error if not)
3. If quest is not active (byte at +0x09 == 0):
   Set unit animation mode to 3 (quest complete animation)

Parameters:
  pCallbackData (ECX) - Callback data structure:
    +0x00: pGame - Game instance pointer
    +0x04: pUnit - Unit to animate

Returns: void

Magic Numbers:
  5       - Quest ID for Tools of the Trade
  3       - Animation mode (quest complete)
  0x423   - Debug line number for assertion

0x6FCBB400.name: ProcessToolsOfTradeUnitEvent
0x6FCBB400.comment:
Processes unit event for Tools of the Trade quest, tracking interacted NPCs.

Algorithm:
1. Find quest 5 data using FindClientById
2. Get quest data buffer from pQuestInfo+0x18
3. Extract unit GUID from event data (ppEventData[1]+0x08)
4. Search existing interaction list for duplicate GUID (max 8 entries at offset 0x68)
5. If not found and list not full (<8), add GUID to list and increment count
6. Call ProcessMissileTargetSpawning to handle any spawning logic
7. If quest flag at data+0x118 is set and data+0x119 is clear:
   Schedule unit event type 7 at current tick + 10

Parameters:
  ppEventData (ECX) - Pointer to event data array:
    [0] = pGame pointer (for FindClientById)
    [1] = pUnit pointer (GUID at +0x08)

Returns: void

Quest Data Buffer Access:
  +0x68   32    Interaction GUID list (max 8 entries)
  +0x88   2     wInteractionCount
  +0x118  1     bProcessingFlag
  +0x119  1     bScheduledFlag

Magic Numbers:
  5       - Quest ID for Tools of the Trade
  7       - Unit event type for quest processing
  8       - Maximum interaction list size
  10      - Tick delay for scheduled event

0x6FCBB4B0.name: TrackSistersToSlaughterNpcEntry
0x6FCBB4B0.comment:
Tracks NPC entry for Sisters to the Slaughter quest (Quest ID 6 - Andariel).

Algorithm:
1. Get player's monster class pointer and trade flag array
2. Check if trade flag 6/0 (quest available) is set - exit if true
3. Check if trade flag 6/1 (quest in progress) is set - exit if true
4. Get NPC's room and verify it has valid entity field
5. Get character tier index from entity field
6. If tier is 0 (Act 1 starting area):
   a. Find quest 6 data buffer
   b. Add NPC GUID to three tracking arrays (offsets 0, 0x84, 0x108)
   c. Set trade flags 6/0xD (tool given) and 6/1 (in progress)
   d. Update act progress for player

Parameters:
  pMsgData (ECX) - Message data with difficulty index at +0x4D
  pNpcUnit (EDX) - NPC unit pointer with GUID at field_8

Returns: void

Quest Data Buffer Access:
  +0x00   132   First tracking array
  +0x84   132   Second tracking array  
  +0x108  132   Third tracking array

Trade Flags:
  6/0     - Quest available
  6/1     - Quest in progress
  6/0xD   - Quest item/reward given

Magic Numbers:
  6       - Quest ID for Sisters to the Slaughter
  0       - Tier 0 (Act 1 starting area)

0x6FCBB580.name: CheckSiegeOnHellNpcInteraction
0x6FCBB580.signature: bool CheckSiegeOnHellNpcInteraction(int * pQuestInfo, int nNpcClassId, int * pNpcUnit, dword * pdwTradeFlags)
0x6FCBB580.comment:
Checks if an NPC interaction is valid for the Siege on Harrogath quest (Quest 6).

Algorithm:
1. Extract NPC unit GUID from pNpcUnit+0x08
2. Get quest data buffer from pQuestInfo+0x18
3. Switch on nNpcClassId:
   - 0x109 (Larzuk): Check if GUID in tracked list (offset 0x00), or check trade flags
   - 0x9B (Kashya): Check trade flags 6/0 and 6/1 for quest availability
   - 0x94 (Akara): Check if GUID in interaction list (offset 0x84)
   - 0x96 (Gheed): Check if GUID in interaction list (offset 0x108)
4. Return true if interaction is valid, false otherwise

Parameters:
  pQuestInfo (ECX) - Quest instance pointer with data buffer at +0x18
  nNpcClassId (EDX) - NPC class identifier
  pNpcUnit (stack+0) - NPC unit pointer with GUID at +0x08
  pdwTradeFlags (stack+4) - Trade flag array for NPC

Returns: true if NPC interaction is valid for quest progress

NPC Class IDs:
  0x109   - Larzuk (Act 5 blacksmith)
  0x9B    - Kashya (Act 1 rogue captain)
  0x94    - Akara (Act 1 priestess)
  0x96    - Gheed (Act 1 gambler)

Quest Data Buffer Offsets:
  +0x00   Tracked GUID list for Larzuk
  +0x84   Interaction list for Akara
  +0x108  Interaction list for Gheed

Trade Flags:
  Category 6, Flag 0 - Quest available
  Category 6, Flag 1 - Quest in progress

0x6FCBB650.name: InitializeSiegeOnHellQuestHandlers
0x6FCBB650.comment:
Initializes quest handler structure for Siege on Harrogath quest (Quest ID 6).

Algorithm:
1. Zero out 15 dwords (60 bytes) starting at offset 0xA0 (handler table)
2. Set up quest handler function pointers at multiple offsets
3. Set quest ID (6) at offset 0xE0, data table pointer at 0xDC
4. Set control bytes: 0x0A=1, 0x0B=0, 0x0C=0
5. Allocate 0x198 (408) bytes of tracked pool memory for quest state
6. Store buffer pointer at offset 0x18, set control byte 0x0D=4
7. Set value 0x25 (37) at offset 0x10
8. Install CheckSiegeOnHellNpcInteraction at offset 0xE8
9. Clear quest state buffer fields and three GUID tracking arrays

Parameters:
  pQuestData (ECX) - Quest data structure to initialize

Returns: void

Handler Function Pointer Layout:
  0xA0 - FUN_6fcbba30 (main handler)
  0xA8 - FUN_6fcbb750
  0xAC - LAB_6fcbbbe0
  0xC0 - FUN_6fcbbd50
  0xCC - FUN_6fcbb810
  0xD4 - LAB_6fcbc2a0
  0xE8 - CheckSiegeOnHellNpcInteraction
  0xEC - FUN_6fcbc260

Quest State Buffer Layout (0x198 bytes):
  +0x00   132   First GUID tracking array (33 dwords)
  +0x84   132   Second GUID tracking array (33 dwords)
  +0x108  132   Third GUID tracking array (33 dwords)
  +0x18C  4     State dword
  +0x190  2     Counter 1
  +0x192  2     Counter 2
  +0x194  1     Flag 1
  +0x195  1     Flag 2

Magic Numbers:
  6       - Quest ID (Siege on Harrogath)
  0x198   - Quest state buffer size (408 bytes)
  0x25    - Value at offset 0x10 (37)
  0x345   - Debug line number for allocation

0x6FCBB7A0.name: SendSiegeOnHellQuestStateIfNeeded
0x6FCBB7A0.comment:
Conditionally sends quest state packet for Siege on Harrogath quest based on trade flags.

Algorithm:
1. Get player's monster class pointer and trade flag array for difficulty
2. Check trade flag conditions:
   a. If flag 6/0 (quest available) OR flag 6/0xF set AND
   b. Flag 6/0xD (quest item given) is NOT set AND
   c. Flag 6/0xE (invalid location) is NOT set
   THEN skip sending packet (return 0)
3. Otherwise call SendQuestStatePacketToPlayer with quest ID 6

Parameters:
  pMsgData (ECX) - Message data with difficulty index at +0x4D
  pPlayerUnit (EDX) - Player unit pointer

Returns: 0 always

Trade Flag Checks:
  6/0x00 - Quest available
  6/0x0F - Quest flag F
  6/0x0D - Quest item given (blocks sending if NOT set)
  6/0x0E - Invalid location (blocks sending if NOT set)

Logic Summary:
  Send packet if:
  - Neither flag 0 nor F is set, OR
  - Flag D is set, OR
  - Flag E is set

0x6FCBB810.name: HandleSiegeOnHellNpcInteraction
0x6FCBB810.comment:
Handles NPC interaction events for Siege on Harrogath quest (Quest ID 6).

Algorithm:
1. Extract NPC class ID (offset 0x14) and interaction type (offset 0x18) from message
2. Get quest data buffer and player unit GUID from message
3. Switch on NPC class ID:
   - 0x109 (Larzuk): 
     a. If interaction 0xA6: Set state 2, flag at data+0x195=1, iterate with callback, send text
     b. If interaction 0xB8: Remove GUID from first tracking array
   - 0x9B (Kashya):
     a. If interaction 0xB7: Send quest text, check trade flags 6/1 and 6/0xD
        - If both flags set: Set state 0xD, advance to state 5, set quest bit 6/0xD
        - Clear flag 6/1, set flag 6/0, add GUID to tracking, send progress packet
   - 0x94 (Akara):
     a. If interaction 0xB3: Remove GUID from second tracking array (+0x84)
   - 0x96 (Gheed):
     a. If interaction 0xB5: Remove GUID from third tracking array (+0x108)

Parameters:
  pQuestInfo (ECX) - Quest instance pointer
  pQuestMsg (EDX) - Quest message with NPC/interaction data

Returns: void

Quest Message Access:
  +0x00   4     pMsgData
  +0x08   4     pExtra
  +0x0C   4     pPlayerUnit (GUID at +0x08)
  +0x14   2     wNpcClassId
  +0x18   2     wInteractionType

Magic Numbers:
  0x109   - Larzuk NPC class
  0x9B    - Kashya NPC class
  0x94    - Akara NPC class
  0x96    - Gheed NPC class
  0xA6,0xB7,0xB3,0xB5,0xB8 - Interaction types
  6       - Quest ID for Siege on Harrogath

0x6FCBB9A0.name: UpdateSiegeOnHellTradeFlagsByState
0x6FCBB9A0.comment:
Updates NPC trade flags for Siege on Harrogath quest based on current quest state.

Algorithm:
1. Get player's monster class pointer and trade flag array for difficulty
2. Check if trade flag 6/0 (quest available) is set - exit if true
3. Check if trade flag 6/1 (in progress) is set - exit if true
4. Find quest 6 data using FindClientById
5. Based on quest progress level (pQuestInfo+0x0C):
   a. If progress == 2: Set trade flag 6/2
   b. If progress == 3:
      - If quest state (pQuestInfo+0x0B) == 1: Set trade flag 6/3
      - Otherwise: Set trade flag 6/4

Parameters:
  pMsgData (ECX) - Message data with difficulty index at +0x4D
  pPlayerUnit (EDX) - Player unit pointer

Returns: 0 always

Trade Flag Updates:
  6/2 - Quest at progress level 2
  6/3 - Quest at progress level 3 with state 1
  6/4 - Quest at progress level 3 with state != 1

Quest Data Access:
  +0x0B  1  bQuestState - Quest state byte
  +0x0C  1  bProgressLevel - Quest progress level (2 or 3)

0x6FCBBA30.name: CollectSiegeOnHellQuestStats
0x6FCBBA30.comment:
Collects quest statistics for Siege on Harrogath quest based on NPC interactions.

Algorithm:
1. Extract message data and get player's monster class pointer
2. Get trade flags and check flags 6/0 (available), 6/0xD (given), 6/1 (in progress)
3. Get quest data buffer, NPC room ID (param_2[2]+4), and unit GUID (param_2[3]+8)
4. Handle specific NPC class IDs:
   a. 0x94 (Akara): Check GUID in array at +0x84, collect type 3 if found
   b. 0x96 (Gheed): Check GUID in array at +0x108, collect type 3 if found
   c. 0x109 (Larzuk): Check GUID in base array, collect type 3 if found
5. If flag 6/1 not set:
   a. Check if unit GUID is in tracking array
   b. If not found, apply state-based logic using DAT_6fd38db4 lookup table
   c. Special case: state 1 + Larzuk + flag 0 not set = collect type 0
6. If flag 6/1 set and NPC not Larzuk/Akara/Gheed: collect type 3
7. Default fallback: collect type 4

Parameters:
  pQuestInfo (ECX) - Quest instance pointer
  pQuestMsg (EDX) - Quest message with NPC/player data

Returns: void

Quest Data Buffer Access:
  +0x00   132   Larzuk GUID array (33 dwords)
  +0x84   132   Akara GUID array (33 dwords)
  +0x108  132   Gheed GUID array (33 dwords)

Trade Flag Checks:
  6/0x00 - Quest available
  6/0x01 - Quest in progress
  6/0x0D - Quest item given

NPC Class IDs:
  0x94  - Akara
  0x96  - Gheed
  0x109 - Larzuk

State Table (DAT_6fd38db4):
  Indexed by quest state byte (pQuestInfo+0x0C)
  Returns stat collection type or 0xFFFFFFFF if invalid

0x6FCBBD50.name: HandleSiegeOnHellQuestCompletion
0x6FCBBD50.comment:
Handles quest completion for Siege on Harrogath quest, spawning reward items.

Algorithm:
1. Get quest data buffer from pQuestInfo+0x18, clear callback at +0xA8
2. If quest is active and player unit exists:
   a. Check trade flags 6/0 and 6/1 - if either set, skip rewards
   b. Set trade flags 6/0xD and 6/1 for quest completion
   c. Update player's act progress for difficulty
   d. Spawn 2 random items from DAT_6fd39268 table (7 options)

6. For stat type 0xF4:

2. Extract NPC index from quest data offset +0x4D
3. Look up trade flags array from monster class at index+4
4. Check trade flag group 9, index 0 (primary flag)
5. If primary flag not set, check flag group 9, index 0xF (15)
6. If either flag 0 or 0xF is set:
   a. Check flag group 9, index 0xD (13) - must be 0
   b. Check flag group 9, index 0xE (14) - must be 0
   c. If both 0xD and 0xE are zero, return without sending
7. Send quest state packet with state value 8

Parameters:
  pQuestData (ECX): Quest data structure pointer
    +0x4D: NPC index byte for trade flag lookup
  pPlayer (EDX): Player unit (UnitAny*)

Returns:
  int - Always returns 0

Trade Flag Checks (Group 9):
  Index 0x00: Primary completion flag
  Index 0x0F: Secondary completion flag
  Index 0x0D: Blocking flag A (prevents send if set)
  Index 0x0E: Blocking flag B (prevents send if set)

Magic Numbers:
  9    - Trade flag group for Tristram quest
  0x4D - Offset to NPC index in quest data
  8    - Quest state packet value sent to player

0x6FCBCC30.name: HandleTristramQuestNpcInteraction
0x6FCBCC30.comment:
Handles NPC interactions for the Tristram quest (Search for Cain).

This callback is stored at quest handler offset +0xCC in InitTristramQuestHandler.
Processes message type 0xB0 (NPC trade) with two interaction types:
- 0x130 (304): Initial dialog trigger
- 0x14E (334): Quest completion interaction

Algorithm:
1. Extract event data: interaction type, message type, quest data, unit
2. Get monster class from unit and index into trade flags array
3. If message type != 0xB0, exit
4. For interaction 0x130:
   a. Set quest state byte at +0x08 to 1
   b. Call SetQuestStateWithDebug(2)
   c. Schedule FUN_6fcbce10 callback
   d. Send quest text to client
5. For interaction 0x14E:
   a. Check trade flag index 1 - if not set, exit
   b. Check trade flag index 0xD:
      - If NOT set: Execute sequence callback if valid
      - If SET: Advance quest state to 5, set bit for player
   c. Update trade flags (set index 0, clear index 1)
   d. Add unit GUID to tracking array
   e. Send quest text to client

Parameters:
  pQuestHandler (ECX): Quest handler structure
    +0x04: Game pointer
    +0x09: Quest active flag
    +0x0C: Quest state byte
    +0x10: Client ID for sequence
    +0x14: Unknown flag
    +0x18: Quest state data pointer
    +0x1C: Unit GUID tracking array
    +0xA8: Callback pointer (cleared on completion)
    +0xE0: Trade flag group index
    +0xEC: Sequence callback pointer
  pQuestEventData (EDX): Event data structure
    +0x00: Quest data pointer (NPC index at +0x4D)
    +0x0C: Unit pointer (UnitAny*)
    +0x14: Message type (0xB0)
    +0x18: Interaction type (0x130 or 0x14E)

Returns:
  void

Magic Numbers:
  0xB0 (176)  - NPC trade message type
  0x130 (304) - Initial dialog interaction
  0x14E (334) - Quest completion interaction
  0x4D (77)   - NPC index offset in quest data
  0x0D (13)   - Trade flag index for completion check
  0x05        - Quest state: completed

0x6FCBCE10.name: UpdateTristramQuestNpcTradeFlags
0x6FCBCE10.comment:
Updates NPC trade flags based on Tristram quest (quest ID 8) progress.

Checks existing NPC trade flags and sets new flags based on quest state.
Flag group 9 is used for Tristram quest-related NPC interactions.

Algorithm:
1. Get monster class data for the unit
2. Index into trade flags array using NPC index from pQuestData+0x4D
3. Check if trade flag 9:0 is set - if so, skip all updates
4. Check if trade flag 9:1 is set - if so, skip all updates
5. Find quest handler for quest ID 8 (Tristram)
6. If quest found:
   a. If quest state byte (+0xC) == 2: Set trade flag 9:2
   b. If quest state byte (+0xC) == 3:
      - If status flag (+0xB) == 1: Set trade flag 9:3
      - Otherwise: Set trade flag 9:4

Parameters:
  pQuestData (ECX): Quest data structure
    +0x4D: NPC index byte for trade flags lookup
  pUnit (EDX): Unit to update trade flags for (UnitAny*)

Returns:
  int - Always returns 0

Trade Flag Group 9 Values:
  9:0 - Quest flag already set (skip updates)
  9:1 - Quest flag already set (skip updates)
  9:2 - Quest state 2 active
  9:3 - Quest state 3 with status 1
  9:4 - Quest state 3 without status 1

0x6FCBCEA0.name: ProcessTristramQuestStatCollection
0x6FCBCEA0.comment:
Processes stat collection for the Tristram quest based on NPC trade flag state.

This callback is stored at quest handler offset +0xA0 in InitTristramQuestHandler.
Determines which stat table index to use based on quest progression flags.

Algorithm:
1. Extract quest data, stat type, and unit from event data
2. Get monster class and index into trade flags array
3. Check three trade flags at group index +0xE0:
   - Index 0xD (13): Completion flag
   - Index 0: Primary progression flag
   - Index 1: Secondary flag
4. If secondary flag (index 1) is set:
   - Collect stats using table index 3
   - Return immediately
5. Check if unit GUID is in tracking array:
   - If found, collect stats using table index 4
   - Return immediately
6. If primary flag NOT set AND quest state byte is valid (1-8):
   - If state < 4 OR completion flag is set:
     - Look up table index from DAT_6fd3a514[state]
     - If valid (not -1 and < 9), collect stats

Parameters:
  pQuestHandler (ECX): Quest handler structure
    +0x0C: Quest state byte (1-8, determines table lookup)
    +0xE0: Trade flag group index
  pQuestEventData (EDX): Event data structure
    +0x00: Quest data pointer (NPC index at +0x4D)
    +0x08: Stat table info (+0x04 contains stat type)
    +0x0C: Unit pointer (UnitAny*, +0x08 contains GUID)
    +0x14: Stat linked list (PoolLinkedList*)

Returns:
  void - Stats added to linked list via CollectStatsByTypeToList

Table Index Mapping (DAT_6fd3a514):
  State 1-3: Uses lookup table value
  State 4+:  Requires completion flag (0xD) set

Magic Numbers:
  0x4D (77)   - NPC index offset in quest data
  0x0D (13)   - Trade flag for quest completion
  0x38 (56)   - Offset to trade flag group in handler (0xE0/4)
  3           - Table index when secondary flag set
  4           - Table index when unit in tracking array

0x6FCBCF80.name: HandleRadamentKillQuestReward
0x6FCBCF80.comment:
Handles quest reward processing when Radament is killed.

This callback is stored at quest handler offset +0xC0 in InitTristramQuestHandler.
Processes the kill event by advancing quest state, setting completion bits,
and spawning reward items.

Algorithm:
1. Check if quest is active (status byte at +0x09 != 0)
2. Send debug packet with "killed_radament_for_quest" message
3. Set quest state to 4 (completed kill phase)
4. Set quest bit for player using trade flag group at +0xE0, index 0xD
5. Get quest state data pointer from +0x18
6. Clear callback at +0xA8, set state byte to 1
7. Get room from unit for item spawning
8. Store room pointer in quest state +0x04
9. Schedule three callbacks: FUN_6fcbd0e0, FUN_6fcbd080, FUN_6fcbd270
10. Clear item count at quest state +0x0C
11. If timer flag at +0x0A is not set:
    a. Set timer flag to 1
    b. Add quest timer callback (FUN_6fcbd240, delay 0xC)
12. Spawn random items based on count at quest state +0x0C
    - Item type 2, level 0x5B (91)

Parameters:
  pQuestHandler (ECX): Quest handler structure
    +0x04: Game pointer
    +0x09: Quest active status byte
    +0x18: Quest state data pointer
    +0xA8: Callback pointer (cleared)
    +0xE0: Trade flag group index
  pQuestEventData (EDX): Event data structure
    +0x00: Game pointer
    +0x08: Unit pointer

Quest State Structure (at +0x18):
  +0x00: State flag (set to 1)
  +0x04: Room pointer
  +0x0A: Timer active flag
  +0x0C: Item spawn count

Returns:
  void

Magic Numbers:
  0x04      - Quest state: kill phase complete
  0x0D (13) - Quest bit index for completion
  0x0C (12) - Timer delay ticks
  0x5B (91) - Item level for spawned rewards

0x6FCBD0E0.name: UpdateTristramQuestOnRoomProximity
0x6FCBD0E0.comment:
Checks player room proximity to quest target and updates Tristram quest progress.

This callback validates that the player is in or adjacent to the quest target room
before updating NPC trade flags and sending quest progress notifications.

Algorithm:
1. Get player's current room via GetRoom
2. Find quest handler for quest ID 8 (Tristram/Cain quest)
3. Get quest state data from handler +0x18
4. Check if player room matches target room at questData+0x04:
   a. Direct match: set fInTargetRoom = true
   b. No match: extract room tile list and check adjacency
5. Get monster class and trade flags for NPC
6. Verify trade flags at handler+0xE0 indices 0 and 1 are NOT set
7. If both flags clear AND player in target room:
   a. Set trade flag index 0xD (quest progress)
   b. Set trade flag index 1 (interaction complete)
   c. Set trade flag 9:5 (additional state)
   d. Send quest progress packet to client
   e. If player in party, iterate party members with UpdateQuestNpcTradeByCharacterTier

Parameters:
  pQuestData (ECX): Quest data structure (contains NPC index at +0x4D)
  pUnit (EDX): Player unit (UnitAny*)

Returns:
  int - Always returns 0

Quest Handler Offsets (from FindClientById result):
  +0x04: Client/game pointer
  +0x18: Quest state data pointer
  +0xE0: Trade flag group index

Quest State Data Offsets:
  +0x04: Target room pointer

Magic Numbers:
  8    - Quest ID for Tristram/Cain quest
  9    - Trade flag group for additional state
  0x0D - Trade flag index for quest progress
  0x4D - NPC index offset in quest data

0x6FCBD240.name: ResetTristramQuestStateOnEvent
0x6FCBD240.comment:
Resets Tristram quest state when triggered by an event callback.

This function is stored as a callback pointer in the Tristram quest handler
initialization. When invoked, it checks quest state and potentially regresses
the quest to state 3 with iteration.

Algorithm:
1. Get quest state data pointer from handler +0x18
2. Check if quest state byte at +0x0C equals 4
3. If state is 4:
   a. Clear flag at handler +0x14
   b. Call SetQuestStateAndIterate to regress to state 3
4. Clear byte at quest state data +0x0A
5. Return true (1)

Parameters:
  nUnused (ECX): Unused parameter (possibly event type)
  pQuestHandler (EDX): Quest handler structure
    +0x0C: Quest state byte (checked for value 4)
    +0x14: Flag byte (cleared when state is 4)
    +0x18: Quest state data pointer

Returns:
  bool - Always returns true (1)

Quest State Data:
  +0x0A: Status byte (cleared on reset)

Magic Numbers:
  0x04 - Quest state value triggering regression
  0x03 - Target quest state after iteration
  0x6fcbcbc0 - ValidateAndSendTristramQuestState callback address

0x6FCBD370.name: ExecuteTristramQuestSequenceCallback
0x6FCBD370.comment:
Executes the Tristram quest sequence callback if conditions are met.

This function is stored at quest handler offset +0xEC in InitTristramQuestHandler.
It validates quest state before executing the sequence callback stored at client +0xEC.

Algorithm:
1. Check quest state byte at +0x0C:
   - If state != 5 (completed) AND quest active flag at +0x09 is set, return 1
2. Find client handler using quest ID from +0x10
3. If no client found, return 0
4. Validate sequence callback pointer at +0xEC with IsBadCodePtr
5. If callback invalid, assert and exit game
6. Execute callback at client handler offset +0xEC (indirect call via piVar1[0x3B])
7. Return callback result

Parameters:
  pQuestHandler (ECX): Quest handler structure
    +0x04: Game pointer (passed to FindClientById)
    +0x09: Quest active flag (nonzero = active)
    +0x0C: Quest state byte (0x05 = completed)
    +0x10: Client/quest ID for FindClientById
    +0xEC: Sequence callback function pointer

Returns:
  int - 1 if quest still in progress and active
        0 if no client handler found
        Callback result otherwise

Client Handler Offsets:
  +0xEC: Index 0x3B (59) - sequence callback function pointer

Error Handling:
  Asserts pQuestInfo->pSequence is valid before calling
  Exits game with -1 if assertion fails

0x6FCBD3E0.name: BROKEN_HandleTristramQuestStateChange
0x6FCBD3E0.comment:
FUNCTION BOUNDARIES BROKEN - MANUAL FIX REQUIRED

Issue: Function body is only 1 byte (PUSH EBP) but actual code extends ~500 bytes.
Cause: Ghidra failed to auto-detect function end during initial analysis.

0x6FCBD4F0.name: ProcessTristramPortalRoomEntry
0x6FCBD4F0.comment:
Processes player entry into Tristram portal room and advances quest state.

Called when a player enters a room to check if it's the Tristram portal room
(entity field 0x31 = 49) and update quest progression accordingly.

Algorithm:
1. Find quest handler for quest ID 8 (Tristram/Cain quest)
2. Validate quest is active (flag at +0x09 == 1)
3. Check quest state at +0x0C < 3 OR sub-state at +0x0B < 2
4. Get room from unit and check entity field for 0x31 (Tristram portal)
5. If portal room:
   a. Clear quest callback at +0xA8
   b. If quest state < 3, advance to state 3
   c. If sub-state < 2:
      - Clear flag at +0x14
      - Check and set quest state data flag at +0x09
      - Call SetQuestStateAndIterate with callback 0x6fcbcbc0
   d. Schedule UpdateTristramQuestNpcTradeFlags callback

Parameters:
  pGame (ECX): Game instance pointer
  pUnit (EDX): Player unit entering the room

Returns:
  void

Quest Handler Offsets:
  +0x04: Game pointer
  +0x09: Quest active flag (must be 0x01)
  +0x0B: Quest sub-state byte
  +0x0C: Quest state byte
  +0x14: Iteration flag
  +0x18: Quest state data pointer
  +0xA8: Callback pointer (cleared on entry)

Magic Numbers:
  8    - Quest ID for Tristram/Cain quest
  0x31 (49) - Entity field value for Tristram portal room
  3    - Quest state threshold
  2    - Quest sub-state threshold

0x6FCBD610.name: GetNpcStorageTypeByTradeFlag
0x6FCBD610.signature: bool GetNpcStorageTypeByTradeFlag(int pUnit, int dwTradeFlag, byte * pbStorageType)
0x6FCBD610.comment:
Determines NPC storage/inventory page type based on active trade flags.

Algorithm:
1. Get player's monster class pointer and extract NPC inventory index
2. Check each trade flag type in sequence (hst, box, tr1, vip, msf)
3. For matching flag, call FindInventoryItemByStatValue with page-specific params
4. If item found, set storage type code and return true
5. If no matching flag found, return false

Parameters:
pUnit (ECX) - Player/unit pointer for NPC interaction context
dwTradeFlag (EDX) - Trade flag identifier to match against NPC capabilities
pbStorageType (Stack+4) - Output byte receiving storage type code

Returns:
true (1) - Storage type found, pbStorageType contains valid code
false (0) - No matching storage type for given trade flag

Storage Type Codes (pbStorageType output):
0x00 - Trade page 1 (tr1 flag, item found)
0x01 - VIP page (vip flag, item found)  
0x02 - MSF page (msf flag, item found)
0x03 - Box page (box flag, item found)
0x04 - Host page (hst flag, item found)
0x05 - Host page (hst flag, item not found)
0x06 - Trade page 1 (tr1 flag, item not found)
0x07 - VIP page (vip flag, item not found)
0x08 - MSF page (msf flag, item not found)
0x09 - Box page (box flag, item not found)

Magic Numbers:
0x20747368 - "hst " (host trade flag)
0x20786f62 - "box " (box/stash trade flag)
0x20317274 - "tr1 " (trade page 1 flag)
0x20706976 - "vip " (VIP trade flag)
0x2066736d - "msf " (misc/MSF trade flag)
0xFF - Initial storage type (invalid/unset)

Called Functions:
GetPlayerMonsterClassPtr - Get monster class data from player
IsNpcTradeFlagSet - Check if specific trade flag is active
FindInventoryItemByStatValue - Search inventory by stat value

0x6FCBD720.name: HandleHoradricStaffItemTrigger
0x6FCBD720.comment:
Handles Horadric Staff item trigger for Tristram/Cain quest progression.

Called when player creates Horadric Staff through crafting (item code "hst ").

Algorithm:
1. Find Tristram quest handler (ID 9) and update quest state counters
2. Get player's monster class pointer for quest bit array
3. Send quest progress packet to client
4. Set quest completion bit [10,11] in player's quest array
5. Find Staff of Kings quest handler (ID 0xB/11)
6. If quest not yet started (byte +9 == 0):
   a. Set quest active flag at +0xE
   b. Initialize animation state at +0x40 to 2
   c. Schedule quest callback via FUN_6fcd8540
   d. If NPC spawned (byte +0x11 == 1), animate and clear map flags
7. If quest started but not completed:
   a. If inactive, set quest state to 1
   b. If not locked, iterate quest state with callback

Parameters:
  nGameContext (ECX): Game session context pointer
  pPlayer (EDX): Player unit that created the Horadric Staff

Returns:
  void

Quest State Structure Offsets:
  +0x09: Quest started flag (byte)
  +0x0B: Quest locked flag (byte)
  +0x0E: Quest active flag (byte)
  +0x11: NPC spawned flag (byte)
  +0x14: Quest iteration byte
  +0x18: Counter value 1 (decremented)
  +0x1C: Counter value 2 (incremented)
  +0x24: Counter value 3 (decremented)
  +0x2A: Completion flag (set to 1)
  +0x2C: Player GUID storage
  +0x38: NPC GUID for animation
  +0x40: Animation state (short)
  +0x46: Animation substep flag

Related Quests:
  Quest 9: Tristram (Rescue Deckard Cain)
  Quest 0xB (11): Staff of Kings / Horadric Staff assembly

0x6FCBD830.name: CheckHoradricStaffQuestItemStatus
0x6FCBD830.signature: int CheckHoradricStaffQuestItemStatus(int nGameContext, int nPlayerGuid, int nNpcGuid, dword * pQuestBitArray, char * pcOutStatus)
0x6FCBD830.comment:
Checks Horadric Staff quest item inventory status for NPC dialogue.

Algorithm:
1. Check if trade flag [7,0] is set - if not, return status 0 (no quest items)
2. Check if trade flag [10,0] or [10,1] is set (quest completed stages)
3. If not completed, search player inventory for quest items:
   - tr1 (0x20317274): Scroll of Inifuss/Bark
   - msf (0x2066736d): Staff of Kings  
   - box (0x20786f62): Horadric Cube
   - vip (0x20706976): Amulet of the Viper
   - hst (0x20747368): Horadric Staff (combined)
4. Determine status based on item combinations:
   - Status 1: Has bark scroll, stage 3 not reached
   - Status 2: Stage 3 reached (has staff parts)
   - Status 3: Stage 6 reached (all parts combined)
   - Status 4: Has msf+box+vip (ready to combine)
   - Status 5/6: Has Horadric Staff
   - Status 9: Quest state progress check
   - Status 11/13: Act 2 final stages

Parameters:
  nGameContext (ECX): Game session context
  nPlayerGuid (EDX): Player unit GUID for inventory search
  nNpcGuid (Stack): NPC unit GUID (unused)
  pQuestBitArray (Stack): Quest progress bit array
  pcOutStatus (Stack): Output status byte pointer

Returns:
  int - Always returns 1

Output Status Values:
  0: No quest progress
  1: Has bark scroll
  2: Has staff parts  
  3: All parts collected
  4: Has incomplete set
  5: Has Horadric Staff, stage not reached
  6: Has Horadric Staff, stage reached
  9: Quest state check
  11: Near completion
  13: Quest complete

0x6FCBDA50.name: InitCowLevelQuestHandler
0x6FCBDA50.comment:
Initializes the Secret Cow Level quest handler (Quest ID 0xD/13) with callbacks and state memory.

Algorithm:
1. Clear 15 DWORDs (60 bytes) starting at offset 0xa0 (callback region)
2. Set data pointer at +0xdc to g_CowLevelQuestData (0x6fd3a530)
3. Enable handler flag at +0x0a
4. Allocate 0x30 (48) bytes for quest state via pool allocator
5. Store allocated pointer at +0x18
6. Set NPC trade flag group = 0xA (10) at +0xe0
7. Set callback at +0xe4: FUN_6fcbd830

9. Set up callback function pointers:
   - +0xa0: FUN_6fcbdc50

   - +0xb0: FUN_6fcbdd50

   - +0xc8: RemoveNpcFromTradeListThunk

   - +0xd4: FUN_6fcbe1e0
   - +0xd8: FUN_6fcbe2f0
   - +0xe8: FUN_6fcbd5c0
10. Set quest ID = 0xD (13) at +0x0b
11. Clear 12 DWORDs in allocated state array

Parameters:

Structure Layout:
